title: Reclassified AGP cash-flow subtotal issue as a source caution
points: Reviewed AGP annual 2024 unconsolidated cash-flow source page and kept the PDF-reported operating cash-flow subtotal rather than fabricating a balancing row.
The database health gate now treats this case as a scoped yellow source-filing caution instead of a red extraction failure.
User-facing caution text points to the linked filing page and explains that the visible operating cash-flow rows appear internally inconsistent with the reported subtotal.
